## 2. Core Turnkey Platforms

### 1. MotoSaaS™ – Two-Wheeler Dealership & 3D Showroom Platform
- **Category:** Automotive SaaS & Dealership ERP
- **Key Modules:** 3D GLB vehicle visualizer (Draco compression, 360° orbital presets), dynamic on-road quotation engine (RTO, state taxes, insurance, EMI), sales CRM pipeline with test-ride license verification, digital workshop job cards (`JC-...`), chassis inventory allocation, cashier billing.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 14, ASP.NET Core 8, Flutter Mobile, PostgreSQL, Azure Container Apps.

### 2. ConnectAI™ – WhatsApp Conversational Commerce Suite
- **Category:** Conversational AI & WhatsApp Business Automation
- **Key Modules:** Official Meta Cloud API v21.0 integration, visual React Flow drag-and-drop automation builder (`@xyflow/react`), pgvector semantic vector store with Gemini/OpenAI embeddings for RAG document grounding, 3-pane multi-agent team inbox, abandoned cart recovery, in-chat Razorpay UPI checkouts, Shopify webhooks.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 15, Prisma ORM, pgvector, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Razorpay.

### 3. TurfMate™ – Sports Arena & Turf Booking Platform
- **Category:** Sports Venue & Recreation SaaS
- **Key Modules:** Real-time slot concurrency locking preventing double-bookings, dynamic hourly peak/off-peak pricing, turf owner partner management dashboard, customer mobile booking app, UPI advance deposits, QR code gate entry check-in.
- **Tech Stack:** Flutter Mobile, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Razorpay UPI, Tailwind CSS.

### 4. UrbanAssure™ – Doorstep Services & Roadside Breakdown
- **Category:** On-Demand Field Services & Emergency Roadside
- **Key Modules:** Two-sided trades marketplace (electricians, plumbing, repair) and 24/7 roadside assistance (towing, jump-start), nearest technician Fused Location matching, foreground live GPS tracking, escrow payments with digital completion signatures.
- **Tech Stack:** Flutter Mobile, NestJS, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Google Maps SDK, Stripe/Razorpay.

### 5. ElectConnect™ – Election Digital Platform & Voter Analytics
- **Category:** Civic Tech & Campaign Intelligence
- **Key Modules:** Assembly constituency GIS mapping, booth-level voter segmentation, field surveyor GPS tracking, targeted bulk WhatsApp broadcast engine, real-time election turnout dashboard.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 14, Flutter, Python FastAPI, PostGIS, Chart.js, Docker.

### 6. FreshGo™ / RetailSync – Hyperlocal Quick-Commerce
- **Category:** Multi-Store Grocery & Quick-Commerce
- **Key Modules:** Multi-vendor grocery catalog, barcode scanning, real-time inventory sync, automated rider delivery dispatch, live order tracking, proof-of-delivery OTP verification.
- **Tech Stack:** React Native / Flutter, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, Razorpay, Firebase.

### 7. Enterprise ERP & CRM Operations Suite
- **Category:** Enterprise Business Management
- **Key Modules:** Multi-tenant Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), multi-tier purchase approvals, automated milestone invoicing & GST/VAT PDF generation, mobile staff synchronization, executive Chart.js BI analytics.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 15, TypeScript, .NET Core, PostgreSQL, Docker, Tailwind CSS.

### 8. Edge AI & Industrial Computer Vision Suite
- **Category:** Applied AI & Industrial Vision
- **Key Modules:** On-device edge AI inference with Google Gemini Nano for offline privacy-first analysis, real-time YOLO ONNX video defect detection, Dify enterprise RAG workflows.
- **Tech Stack:** Python, YOLO ONNX, Gemini Nano SDK, Dify AI, FastAPI, OpenCV.

### 9. High-Throughput Microservice Workers
- **Category:** Cloud Microservices & Messaging
- **Key Modules:** Containerized .NET Core 8 background services running in Docker Alpine, RabbitMQ/Redis queue processing, Polly retry policies, automated Forgejo/Docker CI/CD pipelines.
- **Tech Stack:** .NET Core 8, C#, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ.

## 3. Technology Competencies
- **Mobile Development:** Flutter (Dart, Riverpod, BLoC), Native Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Room DB, Hilt DI).
- **Frontend & Web:** Next.js 15, React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, SSR, PWA, Chart.js, Three.js.
- **Backend & Cloud:** ASP.NET Core 8, Node.js, NestJS, Python FastAPI, WebSockets, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Linux.
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, pgvector, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase Firestore, Isar DB.
- **APIs & Protocols:** Meta Cloud API, Google Maps SDK, HERE Maps API, Stripe, Razorpay, RESTful APIs, JSON, Protocol Buffers.
- **AI & Automation:** LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini), Gemini Nano On-Device, RAG Architectures, pgvector, Dify, Langflow, n8n.
